title: TBFL-EHR-Framework: identity-gated federated learning for electronic health records (code, contracts and run logs)
description: Code, smart contracts, cohort SQL and per-run logs for the paper "Trustworthy Blockchain-based Federated Learning for Electronic Health Records: Identity-Gated Participation against Sybil Attacks". MIMIC-IV data and models trained on it are not included (PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement).
